name: MPI Sintel
description: An optical-flow evaluation dataset derived from the open-source animated short film Sintel, featuring long sequences, large motions, motion blur, defocus blur, reflections, and atmospheric effects.
citation: Butler, D. J., Wulff, J., Stanley, G. B., and Black, M. J. (2012). A Naturalistic Open Source Movie for Optical Flow Evaluation. Computer Vision – ECCV 2012, 611–625. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-642-33783-3_44
